### Install Tailwind CSS and Vite plugin

Source: https://tailwindcss.com/docs

Installs tailwindcss and the @tailwindcss/vite plugin via npm.

```shell
npm install tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite
```

--------------------------------

### Configure Vite Plugin in vite.config.mjs

Source: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/installation/framework-guides/emberjs

Adds the @tailwindcss/vite plugin to the Vite plugins array in vite.config.mjs.

```javascript
import { defineConfig } from 'vite';import { extensions, classicEmberSupport, ember } from '@embroider/vite';import { babel } from '@rollup/plugin-babel';import tailwindcss from '@tailwindcss/vite';export default defineConfig({  plugins: [    tailwindcss(),    classicEmberSupport(),    ember(),    // extra plugins here    babel({      babelHelpers: 'runtime',      extensions,    }),  ],});
```

--------------------------------

### Import Tailwind in CSS using @import directive

Source: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/upgrade-guide

Replace v3 @tailwind directives with a regular CSS @import statement in Tailwind CSS v4.

```css
@tailwind base;@tailwind components;@tailwind utilities;@import "tailwindcss";
```

--------------------------------

### Import Tailwind CSS in app.css

Source: https://tailwindcss.com/docs/installation/framework-guides/symfony

Add the Tailwind CSS import and configure @source to ignore the public directory to avoid recompile loops.

```css
@import "tailwindcss";@source not "../../public";
```

### Get started with Tailwind CSS > Installation > Installing Tailwind CSS as a Vite plugin > Import Tailwind CSS

Source: https://tailwindcss.com/docs

Add an `@import` to your CSS file that imports Tailwind CSS.
